models_evaluated: FGSM adversarial attack on breast cancer pathology deep learning classifiers

links.outcome: Vulnerability of breast cancer pathology deep learning classifiers to FGSM adversarial inputs
links.effect: FGSM attacks caused misclassification of breast cancer pathology images; the authors then built a system with better defense performance. No numeric results are reported in the abstract.
links.quote: We used the adversarial attack algorithm FGSM to reveal that breast cancer deep learning systems are vulnerable to attacks and thus misclassify breast cancer pathology images.

screen.reason: The study tests an adversarial defense safeguard added to breast cancer pathology deep learning models to mitigate vulnerabilities to adversarial attacks.

primary.practice: adversarial defense / robust training against adversarial attacks
